issue_context.title: expected invalid default value for `date default '2020-00-00'`
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
use test;
drop table if exists t3;
set @@sql_mode='NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,STRICT_ALL_TABLES';
create table t3 (a date default '2020-00-00') partition by range (DAY(a)) (
    partition p0 values less than (10),
    partition p1 values less than (20),
    partition p2 values less than (32)
);
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
v4.0.12 & release-5.0 & mysql 8.0.21
```
mysql> set @@sql_mode='NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,STRICT_ALL_TABLES';
Query OK, 0 rows affected, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> create table t3 (a date default '2020-00-00') partition by range (DAY(a)) (
    ->     partition p0 values less than (10),
    ->     partition p1 values less than (20),
    ->     partition p2 values less than (32)
    -> );
ERROR 1067 (42000): Invalid default value for 'a'
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
release-4.0 & release-5.1 & master
```
mysql> set @@sql_mode='NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,STRICT_ALL_TABLES';
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> create table t3 (a date default '2020-00-00') partition by range (DAY(a)) (
    ->     partition p0 values less than (10),
    ->     partition p1 values less than (20),
    ->     partition p2 values less than (32)
    -> );
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
```
Release Version: v5.1.1
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 797bddd25310ed42f0791c8eccb78be8cce2f502

UTC Build Time: 2021-07-31 02:01:43
GoVersion: go1.16.5
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false
```

review_comments: Could we remove this line? We set it in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/26828/files#diff-ff7af5dbd454cd98c804a32d8049cd73e476ad819042c63dbe690502f915afeeR7791
I prefer to keep this because it is a part of a complete test block for invalid dates like `2999-02-30`.
Do we need to add a test like `create table t (a datetime default '2999-02-30 00:00:00');`?

NO_ZERO_DATE means all zero date is not allowed like `0000-00-00 00:00:00`?
NO_ZERO_IN_DATE mean part zero date is also not allowed like `2999-00-00 00:00:00`?
can we add the late one case here?

`NO_ZERO_IN_DATE` is unrelated to `NO_ZERO_DATE`.

```sql
mysql> set @@sql_mode='STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,NO_ZERO_IN_DATE';
Query OK, 0 rows affected, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> create table t (a datetime default '0000-00-00 00:00:00');
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.04 sec)

mysql> select version();
+-----------+
| version() |
+-----------+
| 8.0.25    |
+-----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
